senses.gloss: m. (prob. fr. a root צבח, with format. ד or ר; cmp. next w., a. צָבַע I) [a grab,] a little, few.
units: <cite ref="Targum of II Chronicles 24:24">Targ. II Chr. XXIV, 24</cite> (h. text <he>מצער</he>).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 36:2">Targ. Job XXXVI, 2</cite> (h. text <cite ref="G00597"><he>זעיר</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 5:18">Targ. Is. V, 18</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:2:8">Y. Ber. I, 3ᵇ</cite> top. <he>מן גו דאינון צ׳</he> because they (the verses) are few; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 1:2:10">Y. Sabb. I, 3ᵃ</cite> bot.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 6:4:5">Y. Yoma VI, 43ᵈ</cite> <he>אורכין צ׳</he> endure a little while yet.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 49:9">Gen. R. s. 49</cite>; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 10">Lev. R. s. 10</cite>, v. <cite ref="F00116"><he>וְתר</he></cite>; a. fr.— Pesik.
